summary: Backend-only testing of new features: real 1inch on-chain exchange, HD-derived hot wallet at index 0, encrypted mnemonic at rest, deposit addresses at HD index >=1. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_realswap_and_encryption.py with 12 tests — ALL 12 pass. Regression run of test_fozpay.py: 18/19 pass (1 pre-existing failure unrelated to this iteration).

minor.issue: Pre-existing test_fozpay.py::test_private_coins fails because it hardcodes a stale MERCHANT_TOKEN from a previous deployment; a fresh clone regenerates the admin merchant token. Test needs to fetch token dynamically via /api/merchant. NOT in scope of this iteration.

action_items: Optional cleanup: update test_fozpay.py::test_private_coins to fetch merchant token dynamically instead of hardcoding, so the regression suite is fresh-deploy safe.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1602 lines — still >>700 line threshold; split cabinet/admin/hot-wallet/merchant/invoice routers for maintainability.

exchange() calls _swap_exact with a synchronous web3 wait_for_transaction_receipt(timeout=150) inside asyncio.to_thread — OK, but during a real swap the ledger is debited/credited AFTER the on-chain tx returns, so a mid-request server crash between blockchain confirmation and DB update would desync the ledger. Consider recording a pending ledger row before the swap and reconciling via tx receipt worker.

swap_pct fee is deducted from the ACTUAL received amount only — good. But the ledger debits payload.amount of src (as intended), while the real on-chain send may have consumed slightly less/more due to slippage; you always debit the requested amount. Acceptable if the swap succeeded with exact amount, but worth commenting.

ensure_seed() sets rec_mod.TREASURY_EVM globally on module import path — safe here but be aware that in a multi-worker deployment (gunicorn workers), each worker re-derives it independently on first request; correct but slightly wasteful.

_common_evm_chain iterates rec_mod.EVM dict — order-dependent (relies on py3.7+ insertion order). For BSC/Polygon USDT↔USDC pairs the chosen chain is whichever appears first; fine, but explicit priority list would be clearer.
seed_data_creation: Tests upsert ledger balances in db.wallets for admin uid (BTC=1.0, USDT=100.0) to reach the on-chain branch, then delete them in a finally block. No leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two regression files: /app/backend/tests/test_fozpay.py (rebrand + admin user mgmt + hot wallet — 1 pre-existing failure on private/coins due to stale hardcoded merchant token) and /app/backend/tests/test_realswap_and_encryption.py (real 1inch on-chain exchange + encryption at rest + HD indexing — all 12 pass). Both talk to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and MongoDB (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env). Real on-chain sweeps/withdraws untested because hot wallet has no funds — that is EXPECTED. Ledger-vs-onchain desync window in exchange() is a design comment, not a bug.
rca of the issue: Verified: (1) Real on-chain exchange path in /api/wallet/exchange rejects non-EVM pairs at 400 with Ukrainian 'недоступний on-chain' message and does NOT touch ledger; (2) For supported EVM pair (USDT→ETH on Ethereum), it correctly reaches _swap_exact which queries the REAL ERC-20 balance of the hot wallet and returns 400 'Недостатньо USDT на гарячому гаманці для обміну' with NO ledger debit/credit — proves it is a real on-chain call, not simulated; (3) DB system.wallet contains 'mnemonic_enc' as Fernet token (starts with gAAAAA) and NO 'mnemonic' plaintext field; (4) /api/admin/hot-wallet.evm_address is non-empty, matches HD index 0, and differs from allocated deposit addresses (index>=1).
